title: A party plan to celebrate New Year
displayTitle: Project 2 · 新年庆祝派对计划

sentences.speaker: narrator
sentences.text: Project 2
sentences.ipa: /ˈprɒdʒekt ˈtuː/
sentences.meaning: 项目学习2

sentences.speaker: narrator
sentences.text: A party plan to celebrate New Year
sentences.ipa: /ə ˈpɑːtiː ˈplæn tə ˈselɪbreɪt ˈnjuː ˈjɪə/
sentences.meaning: 新年庆祝派对计划

sentences.speaker: narrator
sentences.text: The students in Class 1, Grade 7 will have a party to celebrate New Year.
sentences.ipa: /ðə ˈstjuːdnts ɪn ˈklɑːs ˈwʌn, ˈgreɪd ˈsevən wɪl hæv ə ˈpɑːtiː tə ˈselɪbreɪt ˈnjuː ˈjɪə./
sentences.meaning: 七年级1班的学生将举办一场派对庆祝新年。

sentences.speaker: narrator
sentences.text: Your class will do the same thing.
sentences.ipa: /ˌjɔː ˈklɑːs wɪl ˈduː ðə ˈseɪm ˈθɪŋ./
sentences.meaning: 你们班也要完成同样的任务。

sentences.speaker: narrator
sentences.text: Work in groups and make plans on how to celebrate New Year.
sentences.ipa: /ˈwɜːk ɪn ˈgruːps ænd ˌmeɪk ˈplænz ˌɒn ˌhaʊ tə ˈselɪbreɪt ˈnjuː ˈjɪə./
sentences.meaning: 分组合作，制订庆祝新年的计划。

sentences.speaker: narrator
sentences.text: A Plan
sentences.ipa: /ə ˈplæn/
sentences.meaning: A 计划

sentences.speaker: narrator
sentences.text: 1 Work in groups and discuss fun ways to celebrate the beginning of the new year and other details of the party.
sentences.ipa: /ˈwʌn ˈwɜːk ɪn ˈgruːps ænd dɪˈskʌs ˈfʌn ˈweɪz tə ˈselɪbreɪt ðə bɪˈgɪnɪŋ ɒv ðə ˈnjuː ˈjɪə ænd ˈʌðə ˈdiːteɪlz ɒv ðə ˈpɑːtiː./
sentences.meaning: 1 分组讨论迎接新年的有趣方式以及派对的其他细节。

sentences.speaker: narrator
sentences.text: 2 Organize your ideas by answering a list of questions.
sentences.ipa: /ˈtuː ˈɔːgənaɪz jɔː aɪˈdɪəz baɪ ˈɑːnsərɪŋ ə ˈlɪst ɒv ˈkwestʃənz./
sentences.meaning: 2 通过回答一系列问题来整理思路。

sentences.speaker: narrator
sentences.text: Use the questions below to help you and make notes of your answers.
sentences.ipa: /ˈjuːz ðə ˈkwestʃənz bɪˈləʊ tə ˈhelp juː ænd ˌmeɪk ˈnəʊts ɒv jɔː ˈɑːnsəz./
sentences.meaning: 借助下面的问题，把答案记录下来。

sentences.speaker: narrator
sentences.text: Questions
sentences.ipa: /ˈkwestʃənz/
sentences.meaning: 问题

sentences.speaker: narrator
sentences.text: Answers
sentences.ipa: /ˈɑːnsəz/
sentences.meaning: 答案

sentences.speaker: narrator
sentences.text: • When and where will the party take placeg
sentences.ipa: /ˌwen ænd ˌweə wɪl ðə ˈpɑːtiː ˈteɪk ˈpleɪsg/
sentences.meaning: • 派对将在何时、何地举行？

sentences.speaker: narrator
sentences.text: • What is the budget for the partyg
sentences.ipa: /ˌwɒt ɪz ðə ˈbʌdʒɪt fɔː ðə ˈpɑːtiːg/
sentences.meaning: • 派对预算是多少？

sentences.speaker: narrator
sentences.text: • What food and drinks will you buy for the partyg
sentences.ipa: /ˌwɒt ˈfuːd ænd ˈdrɪŋks wɪl juː ˈbaɪ fɔː ðə ˈpɑːtiːg/
sentences.meaning: • 你们要为派对购买哪些食物和饮料？

sentences.speaker: narrator
sentences.text: • How will you decorate the place for the partyg
sentences.ipa: /ˌhaʊ wɪl juː ˈdekəreɪt ðə ˈpleɪs fɔː ðə ˈpɑːtiːg/
sentences.meaning: • 你们将怎样布置派对场地？

sentences.speaker: narrator
sentences.text: • Is there a dress codeg
sentences.ipa: /ˌɪz ðeə ə ˈdres ˈkəʊdg/
sentences.meaning: • 是否有着装规范？

sentences.speaker: narrator
sentences.text: • Will there be any music or dancingg
sentences.ipa: /ˌwɪl ðeə biː ˈeniː ˈmjuːzɪk ɔː ˈdɑːnsɪŋg/
sentences.meaning: • 是否有任何音乐或舞蹈？

sentences.speaker: narrator
sentences.text: • What other activities will there beg
sentences.ipa: /ˌwɒt ˈʌðə æˈktɪvɪtiːz wɪl ðeə ˈbiːg/
sentences.meaning: • 将开展哪些其他活动？

sentences.speaker: narrator
sentences.text: We can have a fashion show.
sentences.ipa: /ˌwiː kæn hæv ə ˈfæʃən ˈʃəʊ./
sentences.meaning: 我们可以举办一场时装秀。

sentences.speaker: narrator
sentences.text: Students can wear their favourite clothes or design their own.
sentences.ipa: /ˈstjuːdnts kæn ˈweə ðeə ˈfeɪvərɪt ˈkləʊðz ɔː dɪˈzaɪn ðeə ˈəʊn./
sentences.meaning: 学生可以穿着自己最喜欢的衣服，也可以自己设计。

sentences.speaker: narrator
sentences.text: We can get a large piece of paper and ask our classmates to write down their goals for the coming year.
sentences.ipa: /ˌwiː kæn get ə ˈlɑːdʒ ˈpiːs ɒv ˈpeɪpə ænd ˈɑːsk ˌaʊə ˈklɑːsmeɪts tə ˈraɪt ˌdaʊn ðeə ˈgəʊlz fɔː ðə ˈkʌmɪŋ ˈjɪə./
sentences.meaning: 我们可以准备一张大纸，请同学们写下新一年的目标。

sentences.speaker: narrator
sentences.text: We can also write down our favourite moments from the past year.
sentences.ipa: /ˌwiː kæn ˈɔːlsəʊ ˈraɪt ˌdaʊn ˌaʊə ˈfeɪvərɪt ˈməʊmənts frɒm ðə ˈpɑːst ˈjɪə./
sentences.meaning: 我们还可以记下去年我们最喜欢的时刻。

sentences.speaker: narrator
sentences.text: B Make
sentences.ipa: /ˈbiː ˌmeɪk/
sentences.meaning: B 制作

sentences.speaker: narrator
sentences.text: 1 Once you have a good idea of what you want to do for the party, start writing the draft of your plan.
sentences.ipa: /ˈwʌn ˈwʌns juː hæv ə ˈgʊd aɪˈdɪə ɒv ˌwɒt juː ˈwɒnt tə ˈduː fɔː ðə ˈpɑːtiː, ˈstɑːt ˈraɪtɪŋ ðə ˈdrɑːft ɒv jɔː ˈplæn./
sentences.meaning: 1 明确派对要做什么以后，开始撰写计划草稿。

sentences.speaker: narrator
sentences.text: Your plan should include the following information:
sentences.ipa: /ˌjɔː ˈplæn ˌʃʊd ɪˈnkluːd ðə ˈfɒləʊɪŋ ˌɪnfəˈmeɪʃən:/
sentences.meaning: 你的计划应包含以下信息：

sentences.speaker: narrator
sentences.text: Details of the party: time, place, etc.
sentences.ipa: /ˈdiːteɪlz ɒv ðə ˈpɑːtiː: ˈtaɪm, ˈpleɪs, eˈtsetərə./
sentences.meaning: 派对详情：时间、地点等。

sentences.speaker: narrator
sentences.text: Resources for the party: things for the party and how to get them
sentences.ipa: /rɪˈzɔːsɪz fɔː ðə ˈpɑːtiː: ˈθɪŋz fɔː ðə ˈpɑːtiː ænd ˌhaʊ tə get ˌðem/
sentences.meaning: 派对资源：需要准备的物品及其获取方式

sentences.speaker: narrator
sentences.text: Budget for the party: costs of food, drinks, decorations, etc.
sentences.ipa: /ˈbʌdʒɪt fɔː ðə ˈpɑːtiː: ˈkɒsts ɒv ˈfuːd, ˈdrɪŋks, ˌdekəˈreɪʃənz, eˈtsetərə./
sentences.meaning: 派对预算：食物、饮料、装饰品等的费用。

sentences.speaker: narrator
sentences.text: Timeline of the party
sentences.ipa: /ˈtaɪmlaɪn ɒv ðə ˈpɑːtiː/
sentences.meaning: 派对时间安排

sentences.speaker: narrator
sentences.text: 2:30 p.m.: Students arrive and get things ready.
sentences.ipa: /ˈtuː ˈθɜːtiː ˌpiːˈem: ˈstjuːdnts əˈraɪv ænd get ˈθɪŋz ˈrediː./
sentences.meaning: 下午2:30：学生到场并做好准备。

sentences.speaker: narrator
sentences.text: 3 p.m.: The party begins with a dance from Kitty and Amy.
sentences.ipa: /ˈθriː ˌpiːˈem: ðə ˈpɑːtiː bɪˈgɪnz wɪð ə ˈdɑːns frɒm ˈkɪtiː ænd ˈeɪmiː./
sentences.meaning: 下午3:00：派对以 Kitty 和 Amy 的舞蹈开场。

sentences.speaker: narrator
sentences.text: 3:10 p.m.: Mr Wu’s speech
sentences.ipa: /ˈθriː ˈten ˌpiːˈem: ˈmɪstə wuː s ˈspiːtʃ/
sentences.meaning: 下午3:10：吴老师讲话

sentences.speaker: narrator
sentences.text: 3:20 p.m.: Fashion show
sentences.ipa: /ˈθriː ˈtwentiː ˌpiːˈem: ˈfæʃən ˈʃəʊ/
sentences.meaning: 下午3:20：时装秀

sentences.speaker: narrator
sentences.text: 3:50 p.m.: Students write down their new year goals and favourite moments from last year.
sentences.ipa: /ˈθriː ˈfɪftiː ˌpiːˈem: ˈstjuːdnts ˈraɪt ˌdaʊn ðeə ˈnjuː ˈjɪə ˈgəʊlz ænd ˈfeɪvərɪt ˈməʊmənts frɒm ˈlɑːst ˈjɪə./
sentences.meaning: 下午3:50：学生写下新年目标和过去一年中最喜欢的时刻。

sentences.speaker: narrator
sentences.text: 2 Discuss your plan and make changes if you need to.
sentences.ipa: /ˈtuː dɪˈskʌs jɔː ˈplæn ænd ˌmeɪk ˈtʃeɪndʒɪz ɪf juː ˈniːd tuː./
sentences.meaning: 2 讨论计划，并根据需要进行修改。

sentences.speaker: narrator
sentences.text: 3 Check for spelling and grammar mistakes.
sentences.ipa: /ˈθriː ˈtʃek fɔː ˈspelɪŋ ænd ˈgræmə mɪˈsteɪks./
sentences.meaning: 3 检查拼写和语法错误。

sentences.speaker: narrator
sentences.text: 4 Draw pictures and use colour to make your plan look lively.
sentences.ipa: /ˈfɔː ˈdrɔː ˈpɪktʃəz ænd ˈjuːz ˈkʌlə tə ˌmeɪk jɔː ˈplæn ˈlʊk ˈlaɪvliː./
sentences.meaning: 4 绘制图片并运用色彩，让计划看起来更生动。

sentences.speaker: narrator
sentences.text: 5 Design a colourful cover page for your plan to make it attractive.
sentences.ipa: /ˈfaɪv dɪˈzaɪn ə ˈkʌləfʊl ˈkʌvə ˈpeɪdʒ fɔː jɔː ˈplæn tə ˌmeɪk ɪt əˈtræktɪv./
sentences.meaning: 5 为计划设计一个色彩丰富的封面，使它更有吸引力。

sentences.speaker: narrator
sentences.text: C Share
sentences.ipa: /ˈsiː ˈʃeə/
sentences.meaning: C 分享

sentences.speaker: narrator
sentences.text: 1 Tell your classmates about the main points of your plan.
sentences.ipa: /ˈwʌn ˈtel jɔː ˈklɑːsmeɪts əˈbaʊt ðə ˈmeɪn ˈpɔɪnts ɒv jɔː ˈplæn./
sentences.meaning: 1 向同学介绍计划的要点。

sentences.speaker: narrator
sentences.text: Include details of the theme, time, place, decorations, food, activities, budget and any other information.
sentences.ipa: /ɪˈnkluːd ˈdiːteɪlz ɒv ðə ˈθiːm, ˈtaɪm, ˈpleɪs, ˌdekəˈreɪʃənz, ˈfuːd, æˈktɪvɪtiːz, ˈbʌdʒɪt ænd ˈeniː ˈʌðə ˌɪnfəˈmeɪʃən./
sentences.meaning: 内容应包括主题、时间、地点、装饰、食物、活动、预算及其他信息。

sentences.speaker: narrator
sentences.text: 2 Class vote for the most popular party plan.
sentences.ipa: /ˈtuː ˈklɑːs ˈvəʊt fɔː ðə ˈməʊst ˈpɒpjʊlə ˈpɑːtiː ˈplæn./
sentences.meaning: 2 全班投票选出最受欢迎的派对计划。
